_about: Implementation maturity of each component, kept apart from runtime state on purpose. Edit this file when a component's status changes: implementation is one of implemented | in_development | planned. Nothing here is live state. Keep static/component-meta.json and frontend/component-meta.json identical (tests/test_design_system.py).

components.name: Topology Discovery
components.summary: Builds the service dependency map from Jaeger traces and the compose config.
components.evidence: discovery.py writes dependency_map.json; the topology endpoint serves it.

components.name: Experiment Planner
components.summary: Proposes one experiment: the ranker scores candidates, an LLM agent investigates the top ones, a deterministic plan is the fallback.
components.evidence: planner.py, ranker.py and rank_agent.py are merged and tested; the fallback plan is used when the LLM is unavailable.

components.name: Safety Policy Engine
components.summary: Deterministic checks decide whether a plan may run. The LLM never decides.
components.evidence: policy.validate() runs on every proposal and again server side at approval.

components.name: Experiment Executor
components.summary: Injects the approved fault on the allow-listed target and always rolls it back.
components.evidence: container_stop, network_delay and traffic_spike are in policy.ALLOWED_FAULTS with rollback in inject.py and traffic_spike.py.

components.name: Telemetry Guard
components.summary: Watches Jaeger spans, probes and container health during the fault; aborts on a breach; verifies recovery.
components.evidence: guard.watch and guard.wait_for_recovery are covered by the flow integration tests.

components.name: Analysis & Scoring
components.summary: Scores each run deterministically, asks an LLM for a verdict, and turns saved results into findings.
components.evidence: score_experiment, judge_hypothesis, analysis.py and analysis_agent.py are merged and tested.
